```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dpi = 96,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "100%"
)
source(file.path("..", "..", "pkgdown", "validation-helpers.R"))
bundle <- load_validation_bundle()
```

This page compares RSYC predictions with plot observations for every
combination of response, model scale, and spatial level (model release
**`r bundle$version`**). Each point is one age class of one curve: the
weighted mean of the plot observations (x axis) against the mean RSYC
prediction for the same plots (y axis). Panels show the generic model, the
coniferous and broadleaf models, and the species models. Species are ordered
by number of points.

Below each scatterplot, boxplots show the prediction error
(RSYC − plot) by age class. AGB points with plot means of 400 Mg/ha or
more are excluded, and panels with fewer than three points are omitted. See
[Model validation](validation.html) for the method and the
[Validation explorer](validation-explorer.html) for individual curves.

```{r figures, results = "asis"}
for (y_var in names(response_names)) {
  cat("##", response_names[[y_var]], "\n\n")
  for (scale in names(scale_labels)) {
    cat("###", scale_labels[[scale]], "models {.tabset}\n\n")
    for (level in spatial_levels) {
      points <- validation_points(bundle, y_var, scale, level)
      if (nrow(points) == 0) {
        next
      }
      n_panels <- n_distinct(points$species_name)
      cat("####", spatial_labels[[level]], "\n\n")
      cat(
        sprintf(
          "%s age-class points from %s curves.\n\n",
          format(nrow(points), big.mark = ","),
          format(n_distinct(points$key), big.mark = ",")
        )
      )
      knit_figure(
        validation_scatterplot(points, y_var),
        height = figure_height(n_panels, 1.87, 3.75),
        alt = sprintf(
          "Scatterplots of %s RSYC predictions against plot means for %s %s models, one panel per model.",
          response_names[[y_var]], scale, level
        )
      )
      knit_figure(
        validation_delta_by_age(points, y_var),
        height = figure_height(n_panels, 1.28, 3.85),
        alt = sprintf(
          "Boxplots of %s prediction error by age class for %s %s models, one panel per model.",
          response_names[[y_var]], scale, level
        )
      )
    }
  }
}
```
